title: Rivet Sprint
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -6 dB gain before AAC encoding; stream-only limiter at 0.35 linear amplitude with no makeup gain. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Original all-ages liquid drum-and-bass instrumental for a one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game at a STRICT constant 174 BPM in 4/4. Maintain a dry quantized two-step drum grid from the FIRST SECOND to the final bar: short punchy kick on beats one and three, forward snare on beats two and four, clearly separated closed hats on eighth notes, and one sharp rim-click or muted-key attack between the main beats in every bar. At least eight distinct short midrange transients per two-bar phrase, including the quieter middle. No tempo drift, half-time section, beatless intro, drum dropout, free-time or smeared pad-only bridge. Signature hook: a clipped three-note low synth figure that rises in narrow steps, followed after a deliberate eighth-note gap by a brighter four-note glass-mallet response; the response starts on the next snare and travels downward. Use a rolling but controlled sub bass and brief warm chord fragments, leaving room around snare attacks. At the midpoint keep the SAME uninterrupted two-step grid, move the glass response before the low call, and switch the bass root sequence; the finale combines both motifs into a new staggered cadence rather than copying the first half. One evolving 128-second stereo instrumental, nimble and buoyant, with clean transient separation and no abrasive distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original album cover for duohertz track Rivet Sprint, an all-ages drum-and-bass rhythm-game song. Original high-contrast editorial comic-print collage on a near-black ink field with warm-ivory paper, electric cyan directional accents, restrained coral timing ticks and sparse halftone. Main motif: ONE long broad ivory cut-paper zigzag strip darts from lower left to upper right in three sharp changes of direction; exactly three oversized cyan square 'rivet' markers punctuate its turns, and small coral beat marks trail behind the final turn. The strip should read as a frequency path, not a literal metal rail or road. Strong single silhouette at 100px, clear negative space in the lower fifth for a local title overlay, no tiny clutter. No lightning bolt, arrowhead pair, domino slab, stairs, track lanes, city, vehicle, person, rings, circles, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or copied game art.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Rivet Sprint square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve its one broad warm-ivory zigzag frequency strip with three sharp turns, exactly three oversized cyan square rivet markers and a few small coral beat ticks, all in near-black editorial comic-print texture. Recompose the motif on the RIGHT two-thirds; leave calm near-black space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp legible English lines there: 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan and 'Rivet Sprint' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. No other text, letters, numbers, roads, rails, cars, people, rings, logos, watermarks or copied game imagery. Make a purpose-built wide card, not a stretched square crop.
